column1: # Raw transcription of the STATUS COLUMN of official NFL.com club roster pages.
# Read 2026-11-18 (UTC). Only clubs actually read this session are present; a club
# absent from this file was NOT read and its sweep row is left blank and flagged.
# The roster page renders each player as: name | number | position | STATUS | height | weight | exp | college
# STATUS codes observed verbatim: ACT, RES, RSR, CUT, DEV, PUP, TRC, TRD, TRT.
# IMPORTANT — a first pass of this file recorded only the first rendered chunk per club
# and wrongly concluded that reserve-list players were absent from the pages. The pages
# DO list them (BAL chunk 2, MIA chunks 1-2, HOU chunk 2). The first pass was discarded
# and re-transcribed in full; scripts/roster_sweep.py carries the reason in a CORRECTIONS
